title: homepage search box not link
rule: Home page: search box, not a search link. Advanced search is not the default (most people use one or two terms; advanced as default increases mistakes). Tiny/single-page sites may omit search.
pass_when: Home offers a search field (unless the site is tiny/single-page and omits search); default search is simple, not advanced.
fail_when: Home search is only a link to another page, or advanced search is the default.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
